phrase.en: Do you sell postcards? The price is a bit expensive for me.
phrase.ru: Вы продаёте открытки? Цена для меня немного высока.
phrase.es: ¿Venden postales? El precio es un poco caro para mí.

text.ru: How much is…? / How much are…? — «сколько стоит» (are — для множественного числа). Слишком дорого — too expensive.
text.en: How much is it? / How much are they? (are for plurals). Too expensive = more than I can pay.
text.es: How much is / are…? too expensive = demasiado caro.

examples.en: Can you give me a better price?

exercises.en: What is the price of this bag?
